inputs.analysisSummary: Project is a GitHub Digest + Builder Radar pipeline. CLI has: fetch, analyze-daily, analyze-worker, rank-daily, pair-daily, serve, health, ingest-hn. run_daily_pipeline.py orchestrates all steps and spawns analyze-worker as detached subprocess. Systemd units exist for fetch/summarize/api/radar but install.sh only enables fetch+summarize timers. /health endpoint is basic (repo_count+last_fetch only). No heartbeat/stuck detection. No watchdog. No orchestrate-daily command.
